patches_added.name: Fix push notifications
patches_added.description: Restores push notifications on re-signed builds when LINE is fully closed. If they still don't arrive, use a Root Mount install.

patches_modified.name: Disable LINE Premium
patches_modified.description: Hides all LINE Yahoo Premium (LYP) surfaces — upsells, badges, the Premium settings page, and subscribe/manage flows. Doesn't unlock anything (premium is server-enforced).

patches_modified.name: Disable VOOM
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes VOOM entry points — deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing and the standalone VOOM feed closes on open. Messaging and other tabs are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Hide premium unsend upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes the LYP premium-unsend upsells that survive "Disable LINE Premium": the "Unsend discreetly" button, the post-unsend promo link, and the expired-window unsend upsell. Ordinary unsend still works.

patches_modified.name: Redirect LINE Pay
patches_modified.description: Forwards LINE Pay flows to the standalone LINE Pay app instead of running them in-app, so the device-integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs. Messaging is unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Show author identifier
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show the author identifier next to the nickname in posts, post lists, comments, and the recently-viewed posts list. The recently-viewed list only shows it for posts opened after this patch is installed.

patches_modified.name: Allow reply to feed
patches_modified.description: Allows swiping feed messages to reply, or to comment where chat room comments are enabled.
